rules.hierarchy: Clear text size hierarchy. H1 max text-3xl for internal tools. Tight tracking on headings.
rules.readability: High contrast text. No text smaller than text-sm for critical data.
rules.banned: Do not use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces only. NO glassmorphism. Health/care apps require solid, opaque backgrounds for optimal data legibility.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for cards to distinguish from the background.

layouts.global_wrapper: Assuming the app lives in a layout with a left sidebar (~220px fixed). The content area is ~1200px max-width, center aligned with generous horizontal padding.
layouts.header: Clean top area with breadcrumbs or 'Back to Dashboard' link top right.

Concept_A_Two_Panel_Split.strategy: High-context dual pane. Reduces scrolling by decoupling the attendee list from the form inputs.

structure.left_panel: w-[40%] flex flex-col gap-6 sticky top-0 h-full
structure.right_panel: w-[60%] overflow-y-auto pr-2 flex flex-col gap-3
structure.title_preview: Spans full width above the split panes.

left_panel_elements: Create & Prepare (Primary Button - sticky at bottom or inline after inputs)
right_panel_elements: Attendees List: Custom row components with Checkbox, Avatar, Name, Role, Email. 100% width rows.

Concept_B_Compact_Single_Screen.strategy: Density and efficiency. Power-user mode where everything fits without scrolling.

structure.bottom_row: flex justify-between items-end mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-slate-200

middle_section_elements: Attendees represented as compact pill/chip components (Checkbox, Avatar Initial, Name). 2-column layout to fit 8-15 items cleanly in small vertical space.
bottom_row_elements: Right side: Create & Prepare primary button

components_needed.name: Button
components_needed.style: Primary: bg-[#1E3A8A] text-white hover:bg-[#172B66] rounded-md px-6 py-2 transition-colors. Secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700.

components_needed.name: Select / Dropdown
components_needed.style: White background, solid border-slate-200. Fully opaque dropdown menu.

components_needed.name: Input
components_needed.style: Standard clinical input. h-10, border-slate-200, focus:border-[#1E3A8A] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#1E3A8A].

components_needed.name: AttendeeRow (Concept A)
components_needed.style: Flex row, items-center gap-4, p-3 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white hover:border-[#1E3A8A] transition-colors. Includes avatar, name, role, email.

components_needed.name: AttendeePill (Concept B)
components_needed.style: Flex row, items-center gap-3, p-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white hover:border-[#1E3A8A] transition-colors. Compact size.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. Dark navy on white is accessible. Grey text must be dark enough (e.g., text-slate-600).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. E.g., data-testid='create-meeting-button', data-testid='attendee-checkbox-X'.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on inputs and buttons using focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-[#1E3A8A].

instructions_to_main_agent.action: Implement the two design concepts in the React frontend.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing_strategy: Since the user wants to see BOTH concepts, implement a toggle or tab at the very top of the page (e.g., 'View Concept A' | 'View Concept B') that switches between the two layout components, OR create two distinct routes. A tabbed toggle is preferred for easy comparison.
instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React, Tailwind CSS, raw HTML elements, and shadcn-inspired components.
instructions_to_main_agent.visual_rules: Strict adherence to the #1E3A8A navy color. DO NOT add emojis, gradients, or decorative illustrations. Keep it clinical and highly professional.
instructions_to_main_agent.mock_data: Hardcode an array of 8-12 realistic attendee objects (name, role, email, avatar initals) to populate both layouts.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this. Build distinct, polished UI with precise spacing.
Do NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties (colors, opacity, transform).
Never center-align the main app container in standard text apps; respect left-aligned natural reading flow.
Ensure standard HTML semantics. Use pure functional shadcn components or custom HTML+Tailwind for complex grids.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.
Always apply focus, hover, and active states. Interactive elements must react visually.
